beats.vo: [Inter] can cope without [Alessandro Bastoni] on Saturday.
[Inter] beat Stuttgart two-nil, with goals from [Petar Sučić] and [Lautaro Martínez].
[Federico Dimarco] covered on Wednesday. He can do it again against [Genoa].
[Sky Sport Italia] reports a sore left thigh for [Bastoni], with scans due before [Genoa].
[Genoa] at [San Siro], Saturday at two forty-five Eastern.
